external_input_policy: Full raw bytes, extracted text, headers and images stay in /workspace/scratch/bdef663e3dfc/tmp/access_pilot_v12 outside Git. Publish hashes, provenance, concise paraphrases and reviewed minimal evidence metadata only.

stopping_rule: Stop after these eight listed representations or earlier when remaining attempts cannot add a qualifying representation. Log every outcome and all unusable or incomplete material.
pivot_rule: If the bounded access pilot cannot provide qualifying histories, or accessible histories leave no residual outside direct correction, stop expanding the current longitudinal method claim. Consider a separately named full-document inconsistency evaluation with accessible complete documents, independently reviewed scope and a new frozen design. Do not promote the single selected passage case into a benchmark or silently convert it into temporal evaluation.
